# The Ink Home

> An independent publication of essays on technology, culture, creativity, relationships and the quiet parts of being human.

The Ink Home (https://theinkhome.live) publishes original essays, stories, and reflections by emerging and established writers. Content is published on Medium and mirrored on this domain.

## Key pages
- Home: https://theinkhome.live/
- Stories archive: https://theinkhome.live/stories
- Writers: https://theinkhome.live/writers
- About: https://theinkhome.live/about
- The Desk (drafting tool): https://theinkhome.live/desk
- Submission guidelines: https://theinkhome.live/about
- Editorial policy: https://theinkhome.live/editorial
- Privacy: https://theinkhome.live/privacy
- Terms: https://theinkhome.live/terms

## Notes
- AI-generated submissions are not accepted without disclosure.
- Stories are authored by real contributors.
- No fabricated statistics or testimonials.
